    count = 0
    for sub in subrefs:
        if pd.notna(sub) and ref in str(sub):

    results_f.append(count)

ws = wb.active

# The answer position is F2:F6 (rows 2 to 6, column 6)
for i, val in enumerate(results_f, start=2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=6).value = int(val)

# Save the resulting spreadsheet
